omitted_note: Address and waiter are not read nor stored until Aviso 3.1 is in force (decision 209). Since 2.163.0 the text of VENDOR_NAME, VENDOR_ADDRESS, VENDOR_PHONE and ADDRESS is used only in memory, during the reading, to keep header lines out of item names; it is never stored, logged nor published.
manual_review: Since 2.157.0 (decision 212) there is no manual path. Each row is resolved by its prices: unit and line amount rule over the read quantity, a line amount alone means quantity 1, and rows without price or at 0.00 are not items and invalidate nothing. The printed TOTAL is the control, with finite alternatives (price read as unit, summary rows read as items) adopted only when exactly one closes (two that close are ambiguous and the base stays), and the Blocks of the same AnalyzeExpense response as fallback. Net items equal to the printed SUBTOTAL with SUBTOTAL + tax = TOTAL are read as added tax: amounts unchanged, total_mismatch as before, ticket_totals carries the tax. Items are never empty when rows with price exist; if nothing closes, items come with total_mismatch. Rows naming a person by role (waiter, cook, cashier, user, client...) are never used; a role word after DEL, DE LA, DE LOS or AL is part of a dish name (since 2.163.0). Since 2.163.0: a read quantity above 1 that closes with the line amount is kept when the unit price contradicts it and is weak or contradicted by the printed row, and two strong contradicting signals keep the quantity with low confidence; a value decided by a weak signal yields low_confidence; when the base closes with low-confidence rows, the Blocks reading replaces it only if it closes with every row printing quantity, unit and amount coherently; printed notes, header text and rows at 0.00 are not names; amounts accept 1.234,50 and 1,234.50 only; an unreadable printed TOTAL, or several different TOTALs without evidence (the printed Blocks line or a plain label over PROPINA/SUGERIDA/SERVICIO), give total_mismatch and no total_detected_cents. Two or more documents each with its own TOTAL: items=[], total_cents=0, warnings no_items_found/total_mismatch. Several documents are read as one ticket only when at most one has a TOTAL and it is the last one, no later document repeats the vendor header, and there are no two different receipt ids; otherwise they are not mixed.

warnings_v2.no_prices_found: The photo has text rows and no price at all (a kitchen ticket without amounts). Always together with no_items_found and with items=[]. Never for no rows, all rows discarded or several documents.
warnings_v2.negotiation: HTTP requires contract_version=2 AND warnings_version=2 (exact scalar string). Missing, unknown or duplicate warnings_version returns the base warning list unchanged; v1 and mock never emit no_prices_found.
warnings_v2.client: App Frontend: add warnings_version=2 to the scan request, add no_prices_found to OCR_WARNINGS, and tell the person to photograph the ticket with prices instead of the kitchen ticket.

ticket_totals.source: Textract SummaryFields SUBTOTAL and TAX (services/ocrTextract.js, totalesDeDocumento)
ticket_totals.rule: Only the single (subtotal, tax) pair with subtotal_cents + tax_cents === total_detected_cents exactly. Values containing % are rates and are discarded. Missing SUBTOTAL, TAX or TOTAL, no pair, two pairs, or several documents => absent. No new warning codes.
ticket_totals.negotiation: HTTP requires contract_version=2 AND totals_version=1 (exact scalar string). Missing, unknown or duplicate totals_version returns the unchanged contract without ticket_totals; v1 and mock never emit it.
ticket_totals.invariant: When present, total_detected_cents is present and equals subtotal_cents + tax_cents; the owner throws ocr_response_ticket_totals_invalid otherwise.
ticket_totals.receipt: When the ticket has valid totals the receipt is v2 with t=[subtotal_cents, tax_cents], even if totals_version was not negotiated; otherwise v1 unchanged. Still opaque to the client.
ticket_totals.stored: mesas.metadata.ticket_totals = {version:1, subtotal_cents, tax_cents, total_cents}, written by POST /api/mesas only from an accepted receipt; never from the request body. No migration.
ticket_totals.mesa_detail: GET /api/mesas/:code adds optional mesa.ticket_totals = {subtotal_cents, tax_cents} only when the stored row is valid and mesa.total_cents equals the printed total; otherwise the key is absent.
ticket_totals.client: App Frontend: add totals_version=1 to the scan request, add ticket_totals to OCR_V2_KEYS with the same exact-sum check, and show subtotal and IVA above the total in «Ver el ticket» and the digital ticket.
ticket_totals.with_adjustments: Since 2.164.0 (decision 218): for a client that also negotiates adjustments_version=1, ticket_totals may come without tax_cents (the ticket prints SUBTOTAL and no tax) and its identity includes the discounts: subtotal + tax - discounts = total (discount after the subtotal) or subtotal + tax = total (subtotal already discounted). Without adjustments_version=1 it is only published when it satisfies the classic identity with both keys, so the response stays byte for byte.

ticket_adjustments.shape: ticket_adjustments: [{ kind: "discount", amount_cents: positive integer }], 1..10 entries. The sign is given by kind (a discount subtracts). The printed label is never published.
ticket_adjustments.source: services/ocrTextract.js: a LineItem labelled DESCUENTO, DESC., DSCTO or BONIFICACION with any sign; PROMOCION, PROMO or CORTESIA only with a printed negative sign; otherwise the DISCOUNT SummaryFields (distinct values, without %). A discount row is never an item, for every client. A negative amount without a discount label (for example a DEVOLUCION) is not guessed.
ticket_adjustments.rule: Interpretation "descuento", adopted only when it is the single one that closes: items - discounts = TOTAL (no printed tax, or tax included), or items - discounts + tax = TOTAL with SUBTOTAL equal to the items or to the items minus the discounts (added tax, decision 215). Item amounts never change: the discount is not distributed. If nothing closes, total_mismatch as before and no ticket_adjustments. total_mismatch stays when the items do not sum the TOTAL, as with added tax.
ticket_adjustments.negotiation: HTTP requires contract_version=2 AND adjustments_version=1 (exact scalar string). Missing, unknown or duplicate adjustments_version returns the unchanged contract; v1 and mock never emit it.
ticket_adjustments.invariant: When published, total_cents - sum(amount_cents) (+ tax_cents when added) equals total_detected_cents; the owner throws ocr_response_ticket_adjustments_invalid otherwise.
ticket_adjustments.receipt: When the reading closes with a discount the receipt is v3: d = [amount_cents...] and t = [subtotal_cents, tax_cents | null] or null, even if adjustments_version was not negotiated. v1 and v2 unchanged. Still opaque to the client.
ticket_adjustments.stored: mesas.metadata.ticket_adjustments = {version: 1, discounts_cents, items_total_cents}, written by POST /api/mesas only from an accepted v3 receipt; never from the request body. items_total_cents is the sum of the signed items, the value of a mesa created without editing. With a discount, metadata.ticket_totals is not written (order G, L1). No migration.
ticket_adjustments.mesa_detail: GET /api/mesas/:code?adjustments_version=1 (exact) adds optional mesa.ticket_adjustments = [{kind, amount_cents}] only when the stored row is valid and mesa.total_cents equals items_total_cents (a mesa that was not edited). Without that query, or with an unknown or duplicate value, the response is byte for byte as before.
ticket_adjustments.client: App Frontend (another order, after this is served): add adjustments_version=1 to the scan request and to GET /api/mesas/:code, accept ticket_adjustments and the subtotal-only ticket_totals, show the discount apart in «Ver el ticket» and never distribute it among the people (decision 218).

origin_receipt.emission: ON since 2.145.2; since 2.145.3 HTTP requires contract_version=2 AND receipt_version=1 (exact scalar strings). Missing, unknown or duplicate receipt_version returns the unchanged base contract without receipt; v1 never emits receipt.
origin_receipt.ocr_response_field: receipt?: opaque string; only with 1..100 items; the client never parses it
origin_receipt.create_mesa_field: POST /api/mesas ocr_receipt?: string (<=16384) | null; optional; NOT part of the idempotency hash
origin_receipt.single_use: consumed by the mesa it creates; reused, expired, forged or another user's receipt => every item manual
origin_receipt.server_decides_origin: a per-item origin or item_origins sent by the client is dropped by the schema and never read
origin_receipt.published: never; origins live in mesas.metadata and no response exposes them
